data.title: Example Study A: Generative AI Tutoring and Exam Scores
data.abstract: We ran a randomised controlled trial with 300 undergraduates. Students using a generative AI tutor scored significantly higher on final exams.

data.title: Example Study B: Student Perceptions of Chatbots
Example Study C: No Effect of AI Writing Assistants on Grades
data.abstract: A survey of 1,200 university students found no significant difference in grades between AI users and non-users. Self-reported data is a limitation.
